title: Hold a two-stream blending ratio
physicalPurpose: Move additive demand with production flow before downstream composition error develops.
principalTechnique: Wild-stream ratio station with analyser PI trim and low-flow authority
objective: Configure a blending ratio station, make additive demand follow a valid production-flow change immediately, use downstream composition feedback only as trim, and remove ratio authority safely when wild-flow data are invalid or below the controllable range.

simplifications: Local material-balance linearisation around 100 L/min wild flow and ratio 0.30
One two-second state combines mixing transport and analyser lag
The low-flow case proves authority fallback only and is outside the local composition model
Two deterministic equivalent plants isolate ratio feedforward from identical PI trim

baseline.limitation: Downstream composition feedback cannot move additive flow until mixing lag has produced a measured ratio error.

change.decision: Use ratio authority only with valid scaled wild-flow data above the reviewed minimum, and retain analyser PI as bounded trim rather than a substitute for meter validity.

disturbances: Actual and measured wild flow change from 100 to 120 L/min at 30.0 s
A separate restored run changes only measured wild flow to 125 L/min
Separate fallback runs invalidate wild-flow quality or request 5 L/min

acceptance.window: first controller scan after 30.0-s production event
30 through 60 s ratio-plus-trim IAE divided by feedback-only IAE
80 through 90 s after settling qualification in the +5-L/min meter-bias run
80 through 90 s in the +5-L/min meter-bias run
all samples after invalid quality or below-minimum wild flow

abortPredicates: Any required signal is nonfinite, stale, forced, badly scaled, or has invalid quality
Any additive request leaves 0 through 60 L/min
Blend ratio leaves 0.10 through 0.50 during a qualified local-model run
Plant identity, ratio authority, or restoration state is lost
safety.restorationMode: Track additive request at zero while ratio authority is unavailable; restore valid 100-L/min wild flow and prove measurements and valve state before returning to automatic ratio control.
safety.physicalApprovalRole: authorised blending-skid controls engineer and responsible process operator
simulationOnlyRestrictions: No physical dosing valve or production flow is operated
Low-flow composition traces are not valid evidence for the local model
Physical ratio control requires reviewed meter scaling, valve rangeability, interlocks, safe state and explicit experiment approval

video.viewerOutcome: Configure a wild-stream ratio station with analyser trim and explain its scaling, low-flow and measurement-quality boundaries.
requiredVisibleEvidence: ratio setpoint and both measured ratios

learning.context: A base-liquid wild stream establishes production rate while a separate additive valve controls the material-flow ratio measured after a two-second mixing and analyser lag.
learning.reason: Unlike the nested reactor variables in the preceding cascade lesson, blender quality depends on two flows remaining proportional while one changes independently.
theory: Ratio demand is ratio setpoint times valid measured wild flow; analyser PI supplies only bounded additive-flow trim.
A local material-balance model explains the two input sensitivities and its own invalidity near zero flow.
Bad quality or wild flow outside 10 through 160 L/min removes ratio authority and tracks the reviewed zero-flow safe request.
learning.workedPrediction: A 100-to-120-L/min wild-flow step changes untrimmed additive demand from 30 to 36 L/min immediately; a +5-L/min meter bias creates 1.5 L/min excess demand for analyser trim to remove.
practicalPreparation: Verify Simulation evidence, both plants and controllers, engineering units, meter scaling, quality, ratio authority, limits, sample time and operating point.
Define event IAE, peak deviation, additive-flow movement, final-window eligibility and fallback status before revealing results.
learning.baseline: Run identical composition PI without ratio demand and retain the downstream error that appears before feedback can respond.
learning.change: Add valid measured-wild-flow ratio demand ahead of the same PI trim, then separately introduce meter bias, invalid quality and below-minimum flow.
learning.comparison: Hold plant, state, tuning, physical event, timing, limits, seed and metric windows equal while changing only ratio authority or the declared measurement property.
learning.validation: Require immediate 36-L/min demand, less than 35 percent of feedback-only event IAE, analyser recovery from modest meter bias, and zero tracked request with no quality claim under invalid or low flow.
learning.explanation: Material-flow feedforward acts before mixed product reaches the analyser; feedback repairs modest mismatch but cannot validate a missing, badly scaled or physically singular wild-flow measurement.
learning.transfer: Use ratio control for proportional streams; the next lesson coordinates heating and cooling final elements across one controller output range.
